errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your internet and try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.

warehouse.title: My warehouse
warehouse.searchStock: SKU, name, barcode, lot or warehouse
warehouse.searchMovements: SKU, name, barcode, lot, serial or note
warehouse.emptyStock: There is no stock of your goods in the warehouse yet.
warehouse.emptyProducts: There are no registered products yet.
warehouse.unvalued: {qty} units have no cost yet: they do not add to the value.
warehouse.valueHelp: Calculated with the cost of each receipt, using the warehouse's valuation method.

login.title: Client portal
login.subtitle: Sign in with your email and password.
login.noTrustHelp: Tick it on a shared or public device: you will sign in once, it will not be remembered and you will always be asked for the security code.

errors.invalid: The email or password is not correct. Check that Caps Lock is off and tap the eye to see what you typed. After several failed tries the account is locked for a few minutes and we email you.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.server: The server had a problem. Try again in a few minutes; if it keeps happening, tell your contact at the company.

invite.title: Choose your password
invite.subtitle: You were given access to the customer portal with {email}. Choose your password to sign in.
invite.rule: At least {min} characters. Do not reuse a password from another site.
invite.tooShort: The password must be at least {min} characters long.
invite.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
invite.doneNext: You can now sign in to the portal with your email and password.
invite.invalid: The link is not valid. Ask for the invitation to be sent again.

browser.title: Confirm this computer
browser.sentHelp: This is the first time you sign in from this computer. Open the email and press "Confirm this computer" (the link is valid for 24 hours). You can open it from your phone.
browser.notSent: The confirmation email could not be sent. Try again in a few minutes.
browser.afterConfirm: Once you confirm it, come back here and sign in again.
browser.confirmDone: Done: this computer is now confirmed.
browser.confirmNext: Go back to the sign-in screen and sign in again from the computer where you tried.
browser.confirmInvalid: The link is not valid or has expired. Try signing in again to receive a new one.

captcha.required: Confirm you are not a robot to continue.
captcha.help: For security, confirm you are not a robot.
captcha.nativeUnavailable: To continue, sign in to the portal from a web browser. The anti-robot check is not available in the app yet.

mfa.verifySubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app (or a recovery code).
mfa.enrollSubtitle: To protect your account, the portal requires an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy…).
mfa.enrollScan: Scan this code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy…). If you cannot scan it, type the key below.
mfa.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select them and copy by hand.
mfa.savedCheck: I saved these codes somewhere safe
mfa.recoveryNext: To finish signing in, type a new code from your authenticator app.
mfa.recoveryHelp: Keep them somewhere safe: they work if you lose your phone and are shown only this once.

legal.title: Privacy Policy and Terms of Use
legal.lead: To continue, read the whole document and accept it. If it changes, you will be asked again.
legal.scrollHint: Scroll to the end of the text to be able to accept.
legal.accept: I accept the privacy policy and the terms of use
legal.decline: I do not accept, sign out

lock.title: App locked
lock.help: Use your fingerprint (or your phone PIN) to open the portal.
lock.failed: Could not verify. You have {left} attempts left before the password is asked for.

orders.title: My shipments
orders.noMatchesRange: No shipment matches the search or the dates.

order.title: Shipment
order.noTimeline: There are no status changes yet.

proof.title: Proof of delivery
proof.byStaff: The delivery was registered by the company staff; the consignee did not sign.

notices.title: Notices
notices.help: The summaries your delivery company set up to send you.

settings.title: Settings
settings.biometricHelp: When you reopen the app or after a few minutes in the background, you will be asked for your fingerprint (or phone PIN) instead of the password.
settings.biometricNotEnrolled: This phone has no fingerprint registered. Register one in the phone settings to open with fingerprint.
settings.biometricUnavailable: Open with fingerprint is not available on this device.
settings.computersHelp: From these computers you sign in without email confirmation (30 days without use).
settings.computersEmpty: There are no trusted computers yet.
settings.consigneeNoticesHelp: Your list of consignees: mark who gets notices by email and give them access to their space.
settings.noticePrefsHelp: Which notices you want to receive and how.

install.title: Put it on my desktop
install.help: Install the portal as an app, with its icon on your desktop or home screen.
install.ios: On iPhone and iPad: tap the Share button and choose "Add to Home Screen".

track.title: How is my package doing?
track.tooMany: Too many requests in a row. Wait a minute and try again.
track.privacy: We only show the package progress: never names, addresses or phone numbers.
track.portalLink: Are you a client? Sign in to the portal

prefs.themeHelp: Automatic follows your phone or browser.

messages.help: Your conversation with the customer service team. Only you and the team can see it.
messages.empty: No messages yet. Write to the team below.
messages.tooMany: Too many messages in a row; please wait a while before writing again.

newOrder.title: New shipment
newOrder.help: The same data the company captures: service and dates, consignee, packages and COD. The shipment goes straight into the normal flow and you follow it from “Shipments”.
newOrder.readOnly: Your user can only view. Ask an administrator at your company to let you create shipments.
newOrder.name: Name
newOrder.pickupDefault: Where it is usually picked up

errors.consignee: Choose the consignee or enter a new one (name, address and city).
errors.pieces: Pieces must be a whole number, 1 or more.
errors.cod: The amount must be a number.
errors.date: The ready date must be today or later.
errors.dueDate: The due date cannot be before the ready date.
errors.orderNumber: The order number cannot exceed {max} characters.
errors.invoice: The invoice number cannot exceed {max} characters.

quick.subtitle: One row per shipment, all from the keyboard: Tab moves between fields and Enter saves the row and leaves the next one ready.
quick.hint: Type the consignee and pick it with the arrows and Enter; “+ New” creates it in the same row.
quick.newBlock: New consignee (name, address and town are required)

filters.none: No saved shipment matches the dates and the search.

quick.help: Each row creates one Submitted shipment of 1 package and 1 piece; for several packages use the Detailed entry.

newOrder.s1d: The service type, when the shipment is ready and when it is needed.
newOrder.s2d: Type the name and pick it from the list; if it does not exist, “+ New” creates it right here.
newOrder.s3d: What is being shipped and, if any, how much to collect on delivery.
newOrder.consigneeHelp: Type name, number, address or town.
newOrder.ticketNote: The service price is set by the company per your contract; it is not shown here.
newOrder.codNote: If the driver must collect on delivery, enter the amount; otherwise leave it empty.

consigneeBlock.hint: Enter saves the consignee and continues with the shipment · Esc cancels
consigneeBlock.missing: Enter the consignee's name, address and town.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe from notices
unsubscribe.help: If you confirm, you will stop receiving notices about your shipments through this medium. This cannot be undone from the portal.
unsubscribe.done: Done: you will not receive more notices through this medium.

consigneeNotices.title: My consignees
consigneeNotices.help: The consignees you mark get a link to follow their packages when they go out on route, have a failed attempt or reach a final status.
consigneeNotices.readOnly: Your role is read-only: you can see the notices but not change them.
consigneeNotices.noEmail: Email sending is not configured yet for the company: notices will stay pending.
consigneeNotices.enableHelp: Only the consignees you mark below are notified.
consigneeNotices.warning: By continuing you confirm that the consignee agreed to receive notices about their shipments through this medium. The consignee will be told that you marked them, every message will include a way to unsubscribe, and this change will be recorded.
consigneeNotices.smsHelp: Text sending is not available yet; the preference is saved.
consigneeNotices.bulkHelp: Select several consignees and apply the action to all at once; the warning is accepted once for the group.
consigneeNotices.bulkWarning: This applies to {n} consignees ({channel}). Those without that contact on file or who unsubscribed are not marked and you will be told which.

inbox.title: My notices
inbox.help: The notices that were sent to you about your shipments.
inbox.empty: No notice has been sent to you yet.

chat.help: Your conversation with your client. Only you and the people at your client can see it.
chat.empty: There are no messages yet. Write to your client below.

profile.title: How I receive notices
profile.help: Your client decides whether to notify you by email or text. You can turn them off whenever you want.
profile.disabled: Your client has consignee notices turned off.
profile.unsubscribed: You unsubscribed with the link in a notice.
profile.clientOnly: Only your client can turn it on.
profile.canTurnOn: You turned it off: you can turn it back on.

consigneeAccess.title: Consignee access
consigneeAccess.help: Invite a person from the consignee by email so they can enter their own space: they see their notices, get messages from you and decide whether they want the notices.
consigneeAccess.emailPlaceholder: If left empty, the consignee's main email is used

consigneeMessages.title: Messages from my consignees
consigneeMessages.openHelp: What consignees with access write to you. You and your team answer them.
consigneeMessages.empty: No consignee has written to you.
consigneeMessages.chatHelp: Your conversation with {name}. Only that consignee and the people at your client can see it.
consigneeMessages.readOnly: Your role is read-only: you can read the messages, not answer them.

consigneeOrders.title: My shipments
consigneeOrders.help: Your client's shipments that are delivered to you. View only.
consigneeOrders.empty: There are no shipments for you yet.

invoices.title: My invoices
invoices.readOnly: You can only view them here. Payments are recorded by the company.

noticePrefs.title: My notices
noticePrefs.help: The company decides which notices your business receives and how. Here you can only turn off the ones you do not want.
noticePrefs.emailNotConfigured: Email sending is not configured on the server yet: your preferences are saved, but no emails will go out.
noticePrefs.inbox: Show it in the notice inbox
noticePrefs.channelOff: The company has it turned off.
noticePrefs.unavailable: The company does not have this notice turned on for your business.

kindHelp.PICKED_UP: A summary when your packages are picked up.
kindHelp.OUT_FOR_DELIVERY: A summary when your packages go out on a route.
kindHelp.DELIVERED: A summary of what was delivered and what could not be.
kindHelp.COD_PROCESSED: When the money collected on your deliveries is processed.
kindHelp.INVOICE_ISSUED: When one of your invoices is issued.

profile.title: My profile
profile.name: My name
profile.emailHelp: The email is the one you sign in with, and the role is set by your company or the provider administrator.
profile.companyHelp: These details are changed by the company. If something is wrong, write to them from Messages.
profile.passwordHelp: Changing it signs out your other sessions.
profile.passwordRequired: Enter your current password and the new one.
profile.passwordMismatch: The new passwords do not match.

product.title: New product
product.name: Name
product.costHelp: The cost is used to value your inventory (insurance basis).
product.lotHelp: Check it if the product has a lot number and expiry date.
product.costKeep: Leave the cost empty to keep the current one. The SKU, lot/serial control and unit cannot be changed from the portal.

arrival.title: New arrival notice
arrival.priceHelp: If the product has no cost, the price on the first line becomes its cost.

exit.title: New exit notice
exit.help: What is available is reserved right away; the rest stays pending.

arrivals.title: Arrival notices
arrivals.empty: There are no arrival notices yet.

exits.title: Exit notices
exits.empty: There are no exit notices yet.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Your account data to review, print or take to Excel. Pick a report, set the dates and export.
reports.pick: Pick a report from the list.
reports.none: Your company has no reports available for you yet.

desc.shipments: Every shipment created in the dates: consignee, pieces, COD and status.
desc.byStatus: How many shipments, pieces and COD are in each status in the dates.
desc.cod: The period’s cash-on-delivery shipments and the total to collect.
desc.invoices: What was billed, paid and is owed, per invoice.
desc.stock: What you have in the warehouse by product, warehouse and lot.
desc.movements: Receipts, issues and adjustments of your inventory in the dates.
desc.valuation: What your inventory is worth by the cost of each receipt.

reports.preview: Showing the first {n}; the exported file has them all.
reports.truncated: There are more rows than can be fetched at once (5,000). Shorten the dates to see the rest.

kemi.name: Kemi
kemi.subtitle: Teikem assistant
kemi.hi: Hi! I'm Kemi. What would you like to do?
kemi.hiUnread: Hi! You have {n} unread messages. What would you like to do?
kemi.optAsk: Ask me how to use the portal
kemi.optHome: Send Kemi back to the corner
kemi.askIntro: Tell me what you want to know and I'll explain how it's done.
kemi.askNone: I found nothing about that. Try other words.
kemi.askNoMore: I found nothing more. Try other words or ask your contact at the company.

voice.denied: I don't have permission to use the microphone. Turn it on in your device or browser settings.
voice.no-speech: I didn't hear you. Tap the microphone and try again.
voice.unsupported: This device or browser can't recognize speech. Type your question.
voice.network: I couldn't reach the voice service. Check your internet or type your question.
voice.other: I couldn't understand you. Try again or type your question.

forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If the email is registered, we sent you a link to reset your password.
forgot.sentHelp: Check your email (and the spam folder). The link is valid for 60 minutes and can be used once. If you use two-step verification, have your code at hand.

reset.title: Choose your new password
reset.subtitle: Account: {email}
reset.badLink: The link is not valid or has expired. Ask for a new one.
reset.mfaHelp: The one from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.
reset.done: Done. You can now sign in with your new password. For security, this computer will be confirmed again next time.
